title: ICE Is Running One of the Largest Anti-Left Surveillance Operations in US History
summary: ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations is engaged in far-reaching spying against left-wing activists that rivals the FBI and CIA crackdowns on the Civil Rights and anti-war movements.
llm_summary: ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations division has launched a sweeping surveillance campaign targeting left‑wing activists, employing tactics that rival historic FBI and CIA crackdowns on civil‑rights and anti‑war movements. The operation, described as one of the largest anti‑left intelligence efforts in U.S. history, uses advanced monitoring tools and informant networks to track protests, social media activity, and organizational ties.
